facts.lantern-raised: He raises a lantern in his right hand to head height.
facts.star-in-lantern: Inside the lantern, star-shaped lines show between the bars.
facts.gaze-down: His head is bowed, and his gaze goes downward.
facts.staff-left: In his left hand he leans on a yellow staff.
facts.grey-hood: He wears a gray cloak with a hood, and his beard is white.
facts.white-peak: He stands alone on a white peak (it looks like a snow-covered summit).
facts.pale-sky: The background is a pale blue sky.

glosses.lantern-raised: Checking the spot where he stands by a light he lit himself.
glosses.star-in-lantern: The source of light is within, not outside.
glosses.staff-left: Even standing alone, he has something to lean on.

reversedGloss.excess: Being alone goes too far, and he closes off.
reversedGloss.waning: The time he spent withdrawn is coming to an end.
reversedGloss.blocked: The thinking is done, but he cannot come out.

misdescriptions.wrong: He holds the lantern low to light the ground at his feet.
The scene is in the night sky or under moonlight.
A candle is burning inside the lantern.
